# Fix eject host call

## Pull Request by @mateuszsikora

Eject didn't work correctly in case of removed service - it returned `HUH` instead of WHO`. Additionally I improved a bit logs in eject handler to show host call status in logs

## Walkthrough

This PR removes `fuzzy/00000111.bin` and `fuzzy/00000111.json` from the ignored lists in the w3f-davxy test-runner entries so those vectors are processed. It changes eject logging to emit branch-specific trace messages (OK, "WHO" for InvalidService, "HUH" for InvalidPreimage). It also adds a guard in eject to treat destinations present in the removed-services list as InvalidService ("Service missing"). A new test asserts that ejecting an already-ejected destination returns InvalidService.

  - The removed-services check in `accumulate-externalities.ts` (state invariants and idempotency).
  - Logging branches in `eject.ts` (consistency of emitted messages and sensitive data).
